summary: Verified face-guide overlay on the WEB partner Job wizard check-in selfie end-to-end against preview URL. Logged in as demo partner (Raj Kumar / +919000000003), opened active assigned booking AZOB98D25 (AC Gas Refill, customer Priya Verma +919000000004), advanced the wizard to Step 1 - Live selfie, injected a fake MediaStream (navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia stubbed with a canvas.captureStream so the <video> can go ready without a real camera), clicked wizard-selfie-btn, and observed the CameraCapture overlay with the FaceGuide. critical_code_review_comments: CameraCapture FaceGuide ResizeObserver fallback: when w/h are 0 initially the hint is not rendered -- fine because ResizeObserver fires on mount with contentRect. No action required.
Hint y-position uses Math.min(h - 28, cy + ry + 14) which places hint just below the ellipse; verified visually in screenshot. OK.

SelfieCamera.tsx (expo) listens to visibility to reset ready/busy but the FaceGuide uses useWindowDimensions -- make sure Modal statusBarTranslucent sizing matches dims; cosmetic only, verify on device.
